summary: Describe the actual proposed batch inspected, concrete evidence, deficiencies and the limits of this task-design review.

coverage.requirements: Map the full requested scope to tasks and identify omissions or unsupported additions.
coverage.readiness: Inspect every task and every sourced draft decision; finish routine agent-owned choices, preserve genuine unknowns, and distinguish specification readiness from dispatchability.
coverage.dependencies: Check producer/consumer order and transitive prerequisites, including intentionally changed completed outputs.
coverage.ownership: Check declared reads/writes, serialized shared resources and supported evidence evolution.
coverage.checks: Check executable validation, failure cases, actual wiring and acceptance evidence rather than placeholders.
